stem: In a random sample of 100 students at Luciana’s college, $x$ students said that they liked exams. Luciana used this result to find an approximate 90% confidence interval for the proportion, $p$, of all students at her college who liked exams. Her confidence interval had width $0.157\,92$.

parts.label: (a)
parts.text: Find the two possible values of $x$.

parts.label: (b)
parts.stem: Suzma independently took another random sample and found another approximate 90% confidence interval for $p$.
parts.text: Find the probability that neither of the two confidence intervals contains the true value of $p$.
